name: The Essence of Eranikus
objectiveText: Bring the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight and the Chained Essence of Eranikus to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows . It is there that you will make your choice to aid Ysera's Dragonflight or not. Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight (Provided)  ( 1 ) Item #10455  ( 1 )

comments.body:
"More will be added to the Eranikus quest chain in a future patch (not sure how far off as of right now). I can't reveal anything further at this time, but from what I've seen it's going to be really cool and fairly rewarding." 

from Eyonix on the official forums (posted 2005-08-30)
replies: I suspect this quest was supposed to be a part of some ZG questline, that was never implemented. Eranikus was later used for the Scepter of the Shifting Sands questline for the opening of the Ahn Qiraji gate. I think parts from that original ZG questline was simply converted to fit the AQ gate one instead. This is speculation on my part though. But the events do line up.

comments.body: After you awaken and defeat the Shade of Eranikus, you loot his essence off of him and use it while you're in there to start a mini-quests. All you have to do for it is "use" the brazier in the back of the room you fought him. You recieve the chained essence then. After you leave the temple, go to Itharius' cave and choose the last option you see. That riggers the quest but you lose a decent AoE trinket if you finish the quest. I'm not to sure what the reward of the next step in Winterspring is yet...

For those who missed this quest and already sold theirs [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=10455/chained-essence-of-eranikus]Chained Essence of Eranikus[/url], you would never ever be able to complete it. I opened a ticket and talked to a GM:

- Me
"So, despite the loss, are you telling me there is not a single way, never ever, to complete the quest The Essence of Eranikus (ID 3374)? From all the hundreds or even thousands of quest all around the whole game, 15 years of history, that one quest 3374 is impossible for me to complete? Never ever ever? Is this really how you've designed it? Everything else could be abandoned, retaken, refarmed and so on, except this one?

Please confirm for me there is absolutely no way to complete this quest."

- GM
"I'm afraid that is the case, this is how things were too 15 years ago when this was part of a our newly launched MMORPG as well."

Sold Trinket Solution!

For those people that sold the trinket before taking the quest, i used blizzards Item Restore tool https://us.battle.net/support/en/restoration/. You can restore an item you have sold within the last 30 days, luckily for me this one was there. So i got it sent to my email right away and completed the quest!

Cheers
